news.headline: India bonds give up marginal opening gains as profit booking takes over
news.summary: Indian government bonds fell after initial gains due to profit booking by traders and a sharp rupee decline. The benchmark yield of the 6.94% 2036 bond increased to 7.2185% during trading hours. Last week, the yield had dropped significantly due to lower US Treasury yields and a stronger rupee. Investors now focus on the upcoming Reserve Bank of India's policy decision on December 4.

news.headline: NSEL releases Rs 1,950 crore in one-time settlement, ends 14-year payment default
news.summary: The National Spot Exchange Ltd has revealed a substantial settlement payout of Rs 1,950 crore to eligible claimants, marking the end of a lengthy 14-year legal battle stemming from a Rs 5,600 crore payment crisis. This settlement received the green light from the Mumbai bench of the National Company Law Tribunal, buoyed by considerable backing from claimants.

news.headline: The great Indian stock market comeback. Can the rally sustain and what should investors do?
news.summary: Indian equities staged a sharp 9.7% rally in eight sessions through November 12, reversing months of underperformance. A sell-off in US AI stocks, triggered by Republican losses in the midterm elections and fears of tighter AI regulation, spilled across global technology markets. Earlier, foreign investor outflows, elevated crude prices and rupee weakness had weighed heavily on Dalal Street sentiment.

news.headline: Why is SanDisk stock falling? 5 factors weighing on shares
news.summary: SanDisk shares plunged amid a broad semiconductor sell-off, with falling NAND price forecasts, weaker storage orders from Chinese cloud companies and concerns over AI spending weighing on sentiment. The stock has lost more than half its value over 30 trading sessions.

news.headline: Rupee reversal, debt supply drag India bonds in holiday-shortened week
news.summary: Indian government bonds fell after the rupee lost its positive momentum against the dollar on Monday. A recent debt sale raised concerns about supply when the Indian states auctioned bonds at higher yields. The rupee also ended down 0.3%, reflecting increased dollar demand from large corporations. Benchmark Brent crude oil prices remained close to $92 a barrel, raising inflation concerns in India.

news.headline: Rupee retreats with stocks as rally takes a breather, positive bias lingers
news.summary: After a five-day rise, the Indian rupee faced a setback on Monday, driven by heightened dollar demand from major corporations. This shift in momentum was compounded by profit-taking activities. The rupee settled at 92.91 against the dollar, following a peak of 92.44. Additionally, underwhelming local stock performance fueled a bearish outlook for the rupee. Nevertheless, analysts predict a sustained positive sentiment towards stocks and currencies amid ongoing evaluations.

news.headline: German bond yields edge higher as equity rebound eases safe-haven demand
news.summary: Germany's government bond yields increased marginally on Monday as equity markets began to rebound, leading to diminished interest in safe-haven assets. In the wake of a difficult week for stocks, investors indicated a readiness to engage with riskier assets. The yield on 10-year German bonds rose by 2 basis points, signaling a fall in bond prices.

news.headline: US stocks roar back as Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia as CEO; Nasdaq up 6%, S&P 5%, Dow 3.5%: Stock Market Live Updates
Adani Airport raises $300 mn from 360 ONE Asset, taking total equity infusion to $1.35 bn
news.summary: Adani Airport Holdings Ltd will raise USD 300 million to enhance its presence in India's aviation sector. This investment will contribute to its target of increasing passenger capacity from 96 million to 200 million. The company operates eight airports, handling about 95.3 million passengers in the last fiscal year. The funds will support modernizing existing infrastructure and developing airport cities for commercial activities.

news.headline: Nasdaq futures surge 3% as battered AI stocks gain ground
news.summary: US stock futures showed a significant rebound on Monday after sharp declines in recent weeks. Investor interest is returning to AI-linked stocks following corrected valuations in the market. Chip stocks led this recovery, with major companies like Nvidia and AMD experiencing notable gains. Analysts remain cautious about confirming a sustainable recovery amid pervasive market concerns.

news.headline: Rupee retreats, Goldman calls it a 'port of stability' in AI storm
news.summary: The Indian rupee initially rose to a seven-month high before retreating amid corporate dollar buying. It is on track for a monthly gain of over 2%, bolstered by significant foreign investment in Indian equities. Analysts noted that the rupee's early gains pushed it into overbought territory, prompting some selling. Despite recent fluctuations, the rupee has remained stable compared to other major currencies.

news.headline: Global Markets: 5 key triggers to watch this week
news.summary: Global markets will track five key triggers this week, from Black Friday spending and ECB leadership changes to Asian inflation data, South Korea’s rate decision and business activity.
